messages:
maya: Heads-up: planning a "Community Refapp Sprint" the week of Apr 12 to push a new starter repository and a short webinar to onboard contributors :tada:
maya: High-level goals: 1) 800 repo stars/engagements, 2) 120 webinar signups, 3) 25 MQLs routed to SDR queue
jason: Nice. Do we want a benchmark narrative for the launch post? I can write a box comparing local (quantized) vs hosted tradeoffs with concrete latency & cost numbers
li: Yes please. Target workloads: a chat-style interaction and an embeddings index. I'll produce two short benchmark bullets and a single chart we can reuse in slides
amanda: Suggested tutorial checklist: 1) fork + run example app, 2) swap model config & observe latency, 3) run embedding pipeline and query. Keep each step <20 min and include scripts to measure tokens/cost
jason: I'll add a small bash helper for p95/p99 and cost-per-request. Example snippet for README: ```bash
# measure latency and token usage
python perf_check.py --prompt "hello world" --model rdx-small-q4
```
maya: Webinar format: 40m demo deep-dive + 20m community Q&A. Proposed date: Wed Apr 14 9am PT. @sam can you host infra questions and run a brief failover test?
sam: Yep. I'll simulate a load spike and show the graceful fallback to a smaller quantized variant. I'll also verify the sandbox deploy flow works with limited perms
amanda: Marketing assets list: launch blog, repo with issues & PR template, 2 short Looms for prework, 4 social GIFs, webinar landing + email sequence (3 emails)
li: Messaging note: emphasize "developer-first" and measurable outcomes: "Get a production-like LLM refapp running locally and in the cloud in under an hour". Also include a callout about model variants and cost-control tips
maya: Draft blog lede: 
```
Join our Community Refapp Sprint to build, benchmark, and ship a small LLM reference app. Learn how to run locally, compare inference economics, and deploy a working demo you can extend.
```
jason: Suggest a benchmark blurb near the top: "Typical dev workload: 2-4x cost improvement using prefix caching + quantization on common chat flows (results will vary)"
amanda: I'll convert that into a small badge and an animated comparison GIF for social posts
bot-campaigns: campaign created: community-refapp-sprint, landing-draft: https://redwood.example/refapp-sprint (owner: maya)
maya: CTA will be "Join the sprint" + calendar link: https://cal.com/redwood/refapp-sprint-9am-PT
li: Can we add a "pre-meeting lab" in the repo so webinar attendees can follow along? Short checklist reduces live support needs
amanda: Yes, I'll add a 5-step prework checklist in the README and two Loom demos showing the steps
sam: SDR ask: include a lead form checkbox for "Interested in dedicated capacity trial" and a field for company size. Also include hidden utm params to track source
jason: In the repo I'll include an issue template "Benchmark result" so community contributors can drop their perf numbers and leave notes about hardware
maya: Action items: maya -> publish blog + landing copy (Thu), amanda -> GIFs + Looms + email cadence (Fri), jason -> tutorial + perf scripts (Thu), li -> benchmark bullets + chart (Fri), sam -> webinar ops + lead form (Fri). Dry run scheduled Mon Apr 12 10am PT for a 30-min walkthrough
li: Dry run ack. I'll prepare slides with a single benchmark chart and fallback model notes
maya: Thanks all, keep updates here. Ping if anything blocks :thumbsup:
